from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Each non-background marker on the horizontal line grows upward as a stem.
    # Color 2 grows four cells; color 8 grows three cells, with the same marker
    # color at the tip and color 1 filling the stem.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value not in (2, 8):
                continue
            height = 4 if value == 2 else 3
            for d in range(1, height + 1):
                rr = r - d
                if rr >= 0:
                    out[rr][c] = value if d == height else 1
    return out
'''
